holder-quote: Anand looked speculatively at Pawn. The other Antinium looked back, mystified. Anand had changed. He had spoken with Belgrade. The other [Trapsetter Tactician]—or was he a [Strategist] now?—was different too. He had…broken a bit, when he spoke to Pawn about the Workers and Soldiers that had died under his command. Pawn had brought him to Erin. Now Belgrade went to visit her three times a week and he was better. But Anand had not needed the same. Pawn stared at the [Strategist].
The [Trapsetter Tactician]—his new class, which he was very proud of—drooped, or his antennae did.
The Antinium [Trapsetter Tactician] was unusually nervous as he nodded to Yellow Splatters.
The [Trapsetter Tactician] looked around. He looked at Erin, and then touched his chest.
Belgrade watched as Xrn marched down the hallway. The [Trapsetter Tactician] turned to a Painted Soldier.
What would the Antinium like, Belgrade?
